notes: LOC is wc -l of UE 5.8.3 Renderer/Private/Nanite and Shaders/Private/Nanite files, split by measured line ranges. Internals named [builder] or [runtime] sit in Engine/Source/Developer or Runtime/Engine and are outside the row sum. The cluster builder (Developer/NaniteBuilder) is present in the clone. Shadow-caster internals cite VirtualShadowMaps lines or lines already counted in Cull + raster.

rows.parent: Cull + raster (hierarchy, clusters, HZB, HW/SW raster)
internals: Culls each placement against the view and the depth pyramid, through a hierarchy of instance cells, before any cluster is visited.
The GPU scene already culls placements in one compute dispatch (world-gpu-scene.ts cameraPlanes). ClusteredBatch copies skip every cull (frustumCulled false): PRD-600 Phase 2. Grid cells: PRD-673.
Walks the 4-ary BVH of cluster groups one level per dispatch, rejects a node and its subtree by distance, clip plane, LOD and frustum, then tests each cluster.
ClusteredMesh scans the whole cluster table (selectClusterCut). PRD-600 Phase 3 walks the group hierarchy and prunes by view.
LOD error metric and per-view LOD scale
Projects each group's error through its bounding sphere and draws a cluster when its own error is small enough and its parent's is not, at 1 pixel per edge.
Shipped for perspective cameras (PRD-282: two spheres per cluster, 1-pixel budget). The orthographic case throws and zoom is ignored: PRD-695 Phase 1.
Runs node and cluster culling in one kernel with a work queue and persistent threads.

Off by default in Unreal (NaniteCullRaster.cpp:322-328) and WebGPU gives no forward-progress guarantee between workgroups. Revisit if WebGPU adds one and a pruned CPU walk (PRD-600) is the measured cost.
Frustum, clip-plane, draw-distance and WPO-distance tests
Box tests with near and far flags, global clip plane, instance draw distance, and the distance past which world position offset stops and the fixed raster bin is used.

Frustum: PRD-600. WPO disable distance in shadow levels: PRD-651 (epic branch). Main-view WPO disable distance and pixel-programmable distance are per-primitive and default to 0 (off) in Unreal: deferred until a template ships a dense swaying mesh.
Draws what was visible last frame, builds a depth pyramid, then tests the rest against it in a second pass.
Declined on measurement: PRD-284 (1.28 ms is the whole prize) and PRD-489 (would-cull share 0.013). Revisit with a dense interior or city scene.
Rasterizes clusters whose edges project under 32 px in compute, with fixed-point setup and atomic max into the visibility buffer or a depth-only target.
Main view deferred: needs a visibility buffer (PRD-279 decision 1) and 64-bit image atomics. Depth-only shadow levels need only 32-bit atomics: PRD-696, gated.
Draws clusters with large triangles, or that cross the near or far plane, through vertex, mesh or primitive shaders.
By construction: three's hardware draw rasterizes every cluster of the cut with the game's material.
Bins visible clusters by raster material (fixed function, masked, WPO, displaced) so each bin runs one indirect raster dispatch or draw.

Masked and WPO materials work by construction: the game's material draws the cluster. One draw per material for many meshes is PRD-490 (multi-draw on native). Gap: a positionNode can move a cluster outside its bounds; proposed as a PRD-600 box rather than a PRD.
Raster pipeline permutations and PSO precache
Collects and precaches the raster pipelines for every bin and material permutation.
Pipeline warm-up and the native pipeline disk cache ship (Unreal README, already shipped).
Splits and rasterizes displaced patches after the dice pass.
PRD-668 (dice in compute, hardware draw), gated.
Voxel brick trace in the rasterizer
Traces view rays through 4x4x4 brick masks for voxel clusters.
PRD-669, gated. Off in a fresh Unreal project.
Curve segment raster in the rasterizer
Rasterizes hair curve segments with a DDA walk in compute.
PRD-671 draws strands as camera-facing ribbons with a 0.5 px floor instead.
Shadow view emit and VSM feedback
Emits Nanite depth into cube and virtual shadow maps and reports VSM page use back.
Directional levels: PRD-602. Local-light and cube faces: PRD-695.
Counts clusters, triangles and raster bins per pass for the stats overlay.
PRD-676 cluster rows (drawnClusters, triangles per projected pixel).
Visibility buffer clear and raster context
Clears and allocates the 64-bit visibility buffer and decodes its depth.
No visibility buffer (PRD-279 decision 1). Revisit if the owner reopens decision 1 for the owned engine and every shipped target has 64-bit atomics.
Async raster, shader bundles and work graphs
Runs raster on async compute and dispatches bins as shader bundles or work graphs on platforms that support them.
WebGPU exposes no async compute queue, shader bundles or work graphs (Unreal README, deferred until WebGPU exposes the API).
Unreal 4-era Nanite imposters for tiny instances.
Not in the 5.8.3 Nanite source (no match in Renderer, Shaders or NaniteBuilder). Far representations ship as octahedral impostors (world-impostor.ts).
Console variables, the renderer class, pass setup and the rasterize pass driver.

rows.parent: Shading and materials (shade binning, GBuffer export)
internals: Classifies every visibility-buffer pixel by shading material into bins, with counts, offsets and tile masks.
Needs a visibility buffer that owns shading (PRD-279 decision 1). Revisit with that decision.
Compute material shading and GBuffer export
Shades each bin once in compute (with optional software VRS) and exports the GBuffer.
Same reason. Coarse shading rate is PRD-682 (hardware VRS). Far-cluster shading fidelity is a bake matter: PRD-601, listed under the builder internals.
Registers raster and shading pipelines per material and allocates their bins.
By construction: each three material is its own pipeline.
Uploads per-primitive material slot tables that the shading and raster passes read.
By construction: the mesh carries its material.
Depth export, material depth and composition
Writes scene depth, stencil and velocity from the visibility buffer for the rest of the frame.
No visibility buffer (PRD-279 decision 1). Hardware draws write depth and velocity already.
Registers Nanite primitives into the mesh passes that shade them.

rows.parent: Ray tracing (cluster RT, AS cache, stream-out)
internals: Cluster acceleration structures and BLAS build
Builds cluster-level acceleration structures and BLASes from the streamed cut for hardware ray tracing.
Hardware RT declined at its gate (PRD-645, done): the trace is 12-15x faster but no transport reaches 2x end to end. Revisit with PRD-645's revisit condition.
Reuses built BLASes while the cut stays within a relative error tolerance.
Stream-out of the cut for ray tracing
Writes the view-dependent cut as plain triangles for BLAS builds.
Same as above. ThreeNative's software trace reads a fixed fallback cut instead (PRD-694).
Decodes cluster triangles and edges for ray hit shading.
Cluster data decode and position quantization
Decodes per-cluster bit-packed positions and triangle indices from GPU pages.

The pipeline quantizes the whole mesh (KHR_mesh_quantization) and resident vertices are not per-cluster packed. Deferred with page streaming (PRD-285): revisit when cluster pages exceed a memory budget.
Decodes octahedral normals, tangents, UVs and colours per cluster.
Transcodes streamed disk pages into the GPU page format.
Writes page requests and priorities from the cull pass.
Gives materials the Nanite vertex interface (positions, attributes, derivatives) in raster and shading.
By construction: the game's material reads ordinary three attributes.
Builds one packed view per camera, shadow face or capture with its own LOD scale, and draws many views per pass.
PRD-695: every view takes its own cut, orthographic included. Stereo multi-view: no target ships.
Copies Nanite depth into cube shadow maps for non-virtual local-light shadows.
Selects and prints Nanite stats per pass.
Non-shipping warnings when node, candidate or visible cluster buffers overflow.
Debug only. The CPU cut has no fixed GPU queues to overflow.
Shared types, global buffer sizes and scene data access.
Clusters triangles into 128-triangle meshlets by spatial and connectivity partition (Developer/NaniteBuilder, outside the row sum).
Weights normals, tangents, colours and UV density into every collapse (Cluster.cpp:938-1045, outside the row sum).
Partitions clusters into groups of 8 to 32 by shared edges (outside the row sum).
PRD-281 ported the partitioner to TypeScript. Group size sweep: PRD-601.
Simplifies each group with locked borders, re-clusters it and keeps parent error at least the child error (ClusterDAG.cpp and .h, outside the row sum).
PRD-281 and PRD-282. Voxel and curve branches: PRD-669 and PRD-671.
Builds the 4-ary BVH of groups that the runtime walks (outside the row sum).
PRD-600 builds group child lists at load from clusterGroups instead.
Assigns clusters to pages, constrains them for strip encoding, and bit-packs positions and attributes (outside the row sum).
Builds a fixed DAG cut at relative error 1.0 (2.0 for the ray tracing proxy) for consumers that do not run the cull (outside the row sum).
PRD-694: the GI trace and trimesh colliders read a fixed cut, not the camera cut.
[builder] Displacement, skinning and ray tracing encode
Bakes displacement bounds, bone influences per cluster and ray tracing data (outside the row sum).
Displacement: PRD-668. Skinning: PRD-678. Ray tracing: deferred with PRD-645.
Builds meshes from instanced parts (outside the row sum).
r.Nanite.AllowAssemblies is 0 and read-only (NaniteResources.cpp:124-128). Revisit when Unreal turns it on by default.
Places axis-aligned capture cards around a mesh for the Lumen surface cache (MeshUtilities, outside the row sum).
PRD-639 (epic branch) uses a UV-space cache, so no cards are needed. Lumen breakdown owns the decision.
Streams cluster pages and coarse fallback meshes under a 512 MB pool (Runtime/Engine, outside the row sum).
PRD-285: vertex data is about 74% of resident bytes and no asset exceeds memory.
41 debug views: triangles, clusters, groups, pages, overdraw, raster and shading bins.
PRD-676 ports overdraw and cluster views an agent reads from a capture. Bin views have no counterpart.
Prints node, cluster and pixel counts on screen.
Editor debug view modes (shader complexity, LOD colouring) for Nanite pixels.
Debug only; PRD-676 covers the views an agent reads.
Hit proxies, selection outline and editor picking for Nanite meshes.
Editor only: out of scope by rule (no editor).
Rasterizes curve clusters in compute with a minimum width.
PRD-671 ribbons with a 0.5 px floor and coverage.
Decodes and transforms curve control points per cluster.
r.Nanite.AllowCurves is 0 and read-only. PRD-671 reads glTF LINES directly. Revisit when curves are on by default.
Traces view rays through 64-bit brick masks.
Bins bricks into 8x8 screen tiles for the compute trace.
PRD-669 draws one instanced box per brick in hardware, so no tile binning. Revisit if its Phase 3 cost fails.
Experimental voxelization of the depth buffer.
Experimental in Unreal and off by default with voxels.
Precomputed barycentric patterns for edge factors up to 14.
Edge factors from view depth and dice rate, with fade by projected displacement.
Splits large patches and dices them into micro-triangles under a patch budget.
Displacement, spline and skinning deformation of cluster vertices and bounds.
One indirect hardware draw per translucent material bin in the translucent base pass.
Vertex interface for translucent cluster draws.
By construction three's forward path; PRD-677 proves blend state survives the swap.
Skips raster and shading bins no visible primitive uses (off by default).
By construction: three culls each mesh and draws its own material.
Owner-no-see and only-owner-see bits per primitive per view.
Object3D.layers ships it; PRD-678 proves it after a re-cut.
Per-view deform decision by minimum screen size.
Hides filtered primitives per view and scatters small GPU buffer updates.
Directional clipmap shadow views and LOD bias
One Nanite view per clipmap level with a shadow pixel budget (VirtualShadowMapArray.cpp:4948-5035; not in Nanite LOC).
One view per cube face or spot map, culled to the light radius (VirtualShadowMapArray.cpp:5039-5103; not in Nanite LOC).
Small-triangle depth raster into shadow pages
32-bit atomic max of depth into VSM pages (NaniteWritePixel.ush:20-31, 79-94; counted in Cull + raster).
Scales the shadow pixel budget when over a time budget (NaniteCullRaster.cpp:331-354; counted in Cull + raster).
Off by default in Unreal. PRD-602 keeps gateScale as the lever and adds no second budget.
Experimental: re-renders shadow pages when streamed LOD catches up (NaniteCullRaster.cpp:111-117; counted in Cull + raster).
Off by default. PRD-602 makes the shadow cut camera-independent, so a camera re-cut never stales a page.
